sources.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
sources.evidence: The launch explicitly names Luna in the GPT-6 family and announces API, Work and Codex access. Similar training methods to Astra do not establish identical architecture or weights. The article supplies no parameter counts.

sources.title: GPT-6 Luna API model reference
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model reference lists the undated gpt-6-luna snapshot, 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output; text/image input and text output; reasoning effort none, low, medium(default), high, xhigh and max. Function calling works in Responses; Chat Completions permits it only at none reasoning effort.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: September 22 explicitly releases gpt-6-luna. September 25 records an image-encoding fix for API/Codex. October 7 updates chat-latest separately. Decisions API support for Luna began in beta October 6 and became generally available October 22; October 15 voice delegation does not establish native Luna audio input.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card — September 22 Sol/Luna appendix
sources.evidence: The changelog dates the added Sol/Luna appendix September 22. Appendix A identifies the exact model; A.1 says it uses the same types of data and training as Astra. Luna-specific safety, health and capability tables report evaluation results, not production counts or structural topology. Full extracted text was checked for parameter and architecture disclosures.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Sol System Card
sources.evidence: Later September 29 addendum includes exact GPT-6 Luna comparisons, including Table 7 HealthBench and biological-capability tables. These report scores and response lengths, not parameter counts. Training and structural-term checks found no Luna architecture disclosure.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Terra System Card
sources.evidence: October 26 addendum includes exact gpt-6-luna columns in vision, health, safety and biological capability comparisons, including the multimodal troubleshooting table. No total/active count or production architecture is provided for Luna in the reviewed training and comparison material.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna: October 2026 update
sources.evidence: October 7 card explicitly distinguishes new ChatGPT versions from September versions retained in Work/Codex. Its training and comparison sections supply no parameter counts or network architecture. It does not establish that the gpt-6-luna production API alias switched to the ChatGPT variant.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide covers GPT-5.6-and-later cache controls and describes reusable KV tensors. Exact Luna reference lists prompt caching, but KV terminology does not explicitly identify Luna as Transformer or disclose dense/MoE topology.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived recipe explains Transformer attention but explicitly applies only to models before GPT-5.6. Its architecture description is not transferred to GPT-6 Luna.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Vision-capable models receive PDFs as extracted text and page images. Combined with exact Luna vision and endpoint support, this establishes PDF as an API document input format, not an additional native sensory modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Service access is limited and nonexclusive; section 9.1 reserves service intellectual property and transfers no ownership rights. With hosted distribution this supports a descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: Lists hosted GPT-6 Luna separately from the explicitly open-weight gpt-oss models. No Luna checkpoint or open-weight distribution is offered in the reviewed inventory or launch materials.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact gpt-6-luna matches identify it as a replacement for older models, not a model with a listed shutdown date. This is a documentation check, not an endpoint execution test.

sources.title: EU AI Act model training-summary directory
sources.evidence: Current linked summaries include GPT-5.6 Luna and GPT-6 Astra but no exact GPT-6 Luna summary. Their model-specific training quantities are not transferred to Luna.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-6 Luna record
sources.evidence: The baseline lead was accessed through the raw file. Its specifications and September 22 date were checked against primary sources; its promotional description and cross-generation family are corrected.

family.note: Normalize to the GPT-6 generation; Luna is a capability tier across generations.

release_date.note: Explicit public/API release date. September 3 is the original Astra card date, not the later-added Luna appendix release. October ChatGPT variants are separate.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted API/Work/Codex; no Luna weights are offered in the reviewed release or inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access under service terms, not an SPDX checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: No total count is disclosed in the original Luna appendix, later exact-model comparisons or checked training material. Targeted first-party parameter, training and interpretability searches found no exact count. Benchmark scores, token quantities and another model’s training summary are not parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count or routing breakdown for this exact model in the checked original and later sources. No dense/MoE assumption or total=active inference is made.

architecture.note: Exact-model training, comparison and targeted architecture/interpretability searches did not establish production topology. KV caching alone is insufficient, and the older Transformer recipe explicitly excludes this generation. Similar training methods to Astra do not prove architectural identity.

context_window.note: Exact current API total context; maximum input 922,000 and maximum output 128,000 tokens are explicitly listed. Product chat limits are separate.

modalities.note: Native API input is text/image and output is text. PDF is retained as an API format converted to text/page images. Hosted image-generation tools and GPT-Live delegation do not establish native image output or audio input.

reasoning.note: Reasoning tokens supported; efforts none, low, medium(default), high, xhigh and max. Optional none does not negate reasoning capability.

tool_call.note: Responses supports built-in tools and function calling. Exact model reference also permits function calling in Chat Completions only with reasoning_effort=none; the Astra Responses-only restriction is not transferred.

description.value: GPT-6 reasoning model for focused, high-volume tasks, with text and image input and tool calling.
description.note: Replace comparative efficiency promotion with documented purpose and capabilities.

patch.notes: Released September 22, 2026 in the API, Work and Codex. The model reference lists only the undated gpt-6-luna identifier, not an immutable dated snapshot. Current API limits are 1,050,000 context, 922,000 input and 128,000 output tokens. Reasoning supports none through max with medium as default. Use Responses for built-in tools; Chat Completions function calling requires reasoning_effort=none. PDF denotes API extraction into text/page images. September 25 fixed image encoding; the October ChatGPT versions are separately identified in their system card and are not assumed to replace the production API model. Decisions API support was added October 6 and became generally available October 22. Total/active counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified after original and later primary-source checks. No Luna shutdown date was found; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Confirmed September 22 public release, exact API limits and capabilities; correct generation family, proprietary classification, factual description and provenance. Preserve the Luna-specific Chat Completions function-calling exception, separate October ChatGPT variants and later Decisions API support. Counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified after original/later exact-model review.
